_preset: Default — balanced for typical VHS captures
_description: Starting point for most recordings. All detection passes enabled at moderate thresholds. Use dry-run first, inspect detect.json, then remove dry-run for final export.
_signals_expected: silence_overlap (when audio goes quiet at boundary)
uniform_overlap (when colour slate present at boundary)
high_scene_rate (when block cuts faster than file average)

_outputs.detect.csv: Flat interval table with confidence + signals
_outputs.detect.edl: EDL cut list for Kodi / MPC-HC / mkvmerge
_outputs.chapters.ffmeta: Chapter markers for VLC / mpv / Kodi
